tools.name: wildarrange_setup
tools.purpose: 一步接入外置治理：创建治理仓（含 Git 初始提交与默认武装配置）→ attach → init → 生成宿主 Adapter 包；客户项目零写入

tools.name: wildarrange_project_init_governance
tools.purpose: 在项目外创建不覆盖已有文件的治理仓库骨架与默认武装配置；非 Git 目录自动 git init 并提交初始 commit

tools.name: wildarrange_project_attach
tools.purpose: 把客户项目连接到独立治理仓库；映射写入项目外部状态目录

tools.name: wildarrange_project_show
tools.purpose: 查看项目、治理仓库和运行态三根连接

tools.name: wildarrange_integration_accept
tools.purpose: 校验两个仓库的提交与治理注册表，并在项目外运行态写双 SHA 集成验收收据

tools.name: wildarrange_review_configure
tools.purpose: 预览项目审查与执行准备配置；明确确认后 --apply，只能更新治理配置

tools.name: wildarrange_review_checklist
tools.purpose: 解析本任务项目审查清单和必需依据，不启动执行器

tools.name: wildarrange_readiness
tools.purpose: 检查已批准任务必需的执行器、Skill、规范与握手，不启动业务 Worker

tools.name: wildarrange_adoption_inventory
tools.purpose: 只读扫描旧仓库文件与验证资产，供接管 Skill 建立来源映射

tools.name: wildarrange_init
tools.purpose: 在已连接项目的 runtimeRoot 初始化运行态（setup 已包含此步骤）；不写客户仓库

tools.name: wildarrange_plan
tools.purpose: 导入含 responsibilityChanges 的计划；等待人工确认职责与事实归属

tools.name: wildarrange_plan_approve
tools.purpose: 人工确认已导入的计划或新增的职责声明后放行执行

tools.name: wildarrange_run
tools.purpose: 跑下一个任务（worker→verifier→scope→review→checkpoint）

tools.name: wildarrange_status
tools.purpose: 查看状态（含门武装黄灯）

tools.name: wildarrange_decisions
tools.command: wildarrange decisions [--limit N] [--task T001] [--gate pre_tool_use] [--annotatable] [--format json]
tools.purpose: 查看门决策记录（每一次拦截/放行；--annotatable 只看可标注队列）

tools.name: wildarrange_doctor
tools.purpose: 一键体检：配置/完成状态/ledger/备份对账

tools.name: wildarrange_config_init
tools.purpose: 在治理仓 policy/ 生成默认配置（--armed 直接武装质量门）

tools.name: wildarrange_config_show
tools.purpose: 查看生效配置

tools.name: wildarrange_config_baseline
tools.purpose: 写入 config hash 基线

tools.name: wildarrange_config_verify
tools.purpose: 校验 config 基线

tools.name: wildarrange_adapter_install
tools.purpose: 在 runtimeRoot 生成宿主外置插件包；--mode 选择 hook 调用 CLI 的前缀（local 当前 bin 路径 / npx 包名）

tools.name: wildarrange_adapter_activate
tools.purpose: 显式写入用户级配置：Cursor Hook 与指针规则、Codex AGENTS.md 指针段、经 claude CLI 安装 Claude Code 插件；先备份且不写客户项目

tools.name: wildarrange_adapter_uninstall
tools.purpose: 卸载宿主 adapter：移除用户级条目与指针并删除 runtime 插件包

tools.name: wildarrange_adapter_restore
tools.purpose: 恢复 adapter 备份：还原到该次 activate 之前的用户级文件

tools.name: wildarrange_executor_probe
tools.purpose: 内置开工握手执行者：写进 executionReadiness.workerProbe，由开工检查调用；cursor 必须带 --model

tools.name: wildarrange_executor_review
tools.purpose: 内置独立审查者：写进 review.responsibility.command 或审查步骤 command，由审查门调用；cursor 必须带 --model

tools.name: wildarrange_executor_work
tools.purpose: 内置 Worker：写进任务 worker_command，在任务 worktree 中由本机模型 CLI 改代码；cursor 必须带 --model

tools.name: wildarrange_injection_show
tools.command: wildarrange injection show --point before_review [--agent BaiZe] [--task T001] [--text "..."] [--stage plan]
tools.purpose: 查看注入点解析结果

tools.name: wildarrange_hook_run
tools.purpose: 运行宿主生命周期 Hook；只处理已连接项目，未连接项目静默放行

tools.name: wildarrange_workflow
tools.purpose: 连续推进已批准的计划，直到完成、阻塞或需要人工决定；带 --from 时先导入并停在等待 plan approve

tools.name: wildarrange_parallel_run
tools.command: wildarrange parallel run [--max-agents 2] [--task T001,T002] [--agent ZhuRong] [--adapter codex|cursor] [--isolation run-dir|git-worktree] [--command "..."]
tools.purpose: 跑并行子 Agent

tools.name: wildarrange_parallel_admit
tools.purpose: 合入子 Agent 成果（admission 事务）

tools.name: wildarrange_parallel_list
tools.purpose: 列出并行 run

tools.name: wildarrange_parallel_status
tools.purpose: 查看并行运行记录与批次对账

tools.name: wildarrange_parallel_close
tools.purpose: 关闭保留的子 Agent 结果

tools.name: wildarrange_parallel_cleanup
tools.purpose: 清理 Git worktree 隔离目录

tools.name: wildarrange_parallel_retry
tools.purpose: 只重跑未完成任务的局部重试

tools.name: wildarrange_node_route
tools.purpose: 单节点：路由

tools.name: wildarrange_node_execute
tools.purpose: 单节点：执行

tools.name: wildarrange_node_checkpoint
tools.purpose: 单节点：checkpoint

tools.name: wildarrange_node_retry
tools.purpose: 单节点：重试

tools.name: wildarrange_resume
tools.purpose: 恢复会话上下文

tools.name: wildarrange_continuation_check
tools.purpose: 检查会话延续

tools.name: wildarrange_summary
tools.purpose: 生成 workflow 总结

tools.name: wildarrange_rules_collect
tools.purpose: 收集项目规则上下文

tools.name: wildarrange_governance_audit
tools.purpose: 仓库治理检查

tools.name: wildarrange_contracts_scan
tools.purpose: 扫描 Tauri IPC 契约并生成待审核差异卡

tools.name: wildarrange_contracts_apply_card
tools.purpose: 由开发者批准或拒绝当前契约差异卡

tools.name: wildarrange_contracts_generate
tools.purpose: 从已批准契约台账生成人类可读总图

tools.name: wildarrange_contracts_propose
tools.purpose: 提出计划外接口或数据库变更，暂停任务等待人类决定

tools.name: wildarrange_contracts_resolve
tools.purpose: 按当前变更内容记录人类决定，批准后重新验收

tools.name: wildarrange_context_build
tools.command: wildarrange context build [--agent Jiuwei] [--task T001] [--plan <planId>] [--point before_execute]
tools.purpose: 构建指定计划与注入点的 Agent 上下文

tools.name: wildarrange_evidence_record
tools.command: wildarrange evidence record --task T001 --criterion C001 --status pass --evidence "..."
tools.purpose: 回填成功判据证据

tools.name: wildarrange_steer
tools.purpose: 任务变更治理入口

tools.name: wildarrange_review_blockers_record
tools.purpose: 登记 Review Blocker

tools.name: wildarrange_review_blockers_resolve
tools.purpose: 解决任务完成后解除 Review Blocker，被阻塞任务回到 pending

tools.name: wildarrange_task_list
tools.command: wildarrange task list [--all] [--status draft|pending|completed] [--type feature|bug|acceptance_correction|maintenance] [--priority P0|P1|P2] [--owner Jiuwei] [--plan <planId>] [--search "text"]
tools.purpose: 列出当前计划或全项目工单

tools.name: wildarrange_task_get
tools.purpose: 查看单个任务与历史

tools.name: wildarrange_task_claim
tools.purpose: 认领任务

tools.name: wildarrange_task_create
tools.command: wildarrange task create --title "修复登录失败" [--type bug] [--priority P1] [--source user] [--parent <taskRef>] [--writable src/**] [--verify "npm test"] [--review "npm test"]
tools.purpose: 创建工单；验证信息不足时先进入 draft

tools.name: wildarrange_task_create_from
tools.purpose: 从 JSON 创建工单

tools.name: wildarrange_task_ready
tools.purpose: 补齐 draft 并转为可执行 pending

tools.name: wildarrange_task_archive
tools.purpose: 备份后写 ledger 墓碑，并删除非运行中任务及其专属运行态文件

tools.name: wildarrange_team_send
tools.purpose: 发送团队消息

tools.name: wildarrange_team_inbox
tools.purpose: 查看团队收件箱

tools.name: wildarrange_changes_list
tools.purpose: 列出 ChangeRequest

tools.name: wildarrange_changes_review
tools.purpose: 查看 ChangeRequest

tools.name: wildarrange_changes_resolve
tools.purpose: 裁决 ChangeRequest

tools.name: wildarrange_ledger_verify
tools.purpose: 校验 ledger hash 链

tools.name: wildarrange_impact
tools.purpose: 改动影响面分析（反向依赖闭包）

tools.name: wildarrange_test
tools.purpose: 按分区或改动路径选出受影响的测试并运行

tools.name: wildarrange_decisions_stats
tools.purpose: 门触发统计：计数/从未触发的门/标注关联

tools.name: wildarrange_timeline
tools.command: wildarrange timeline [--limit N] [--task T001] [--source ledger|decision|annotation] [--format json]
tools.purpose: ledger+决策+标注统一时间线

tools.name: wildarrange_annotate
tools.purpose: 标注门决策（只进报告，不改配置）

tools.name: wildarrange_annotate_list
tools.purpose: 列出标注

tools.name: wildarrange_annotate_stats
tools.purpose: 标注聚合统计

tools.name: wildarrange_test_2
tools.purpose: 分区/影响面最小测试集

tools.name: wildarrange_docs_commands
tools.purpose: 从命令注册表生成命令文档（单一事实源）

tools.name: wildarrange_state_backup
tools.purpose: 备份运行态关键文件

tools.name: wildarrange_state_verify
tools.purpose: 校验运行态关键文件

tools.name: wildarrange_state_list
tools.purpose: 列出运行态备份

tools.name: wildarrange_state_restore
tools.purpose: 恢复运行态备份

tools.name: wildarrange_serve
tools.purpose: 启动本地 dashboard（默认仅 loopback）

tools.name: wildarrange_adoption_start
tools.purpose: 只读扫描老项目验证资产并打开 Dashboard 逐卡批准

tools.name: wildarrange_adoption_status
tools.purpose: 只读对账接管会话、待决策/过期卡和新鲜度黄灯

tools.name: wildarrange_adoption_resume
tools.purpose: 按磁盘事实恢复接管会话；不安全时只显示 recovery_required

tools.name: wildarrange_adoption_recover
tools.purpose: 重试恢复失败事务的 preimage，成功后释放维护锁

tools.name: wildarrange_guard_scope
tools.purpose: 校验任务范围

tools.name: wildarrange_route
tools.purpose: 请求路由

tools.name: wildarrange_prompts_list
tools.purpose: 列出提示词

tools.name: wildarrange_prompts_show
tools.purpose: 查看 Agent 提示词

tools.name: wildarrange_prompts_show_skill
tools.purpose: 查看 Skill 提示词

tools.name: wildarrange_skills_match
tools.purpose: 匹配 Skill

tools.name: wildarrange_prompts_show_tools
tools.purpose: 查看工具合同

tools.name: wildarrange_prompts_show_routes
tools.purpose: 查看路由表
